## 1. Project Overview

### 1.1 What Is This Project?

**Books Archive** is a Next.js 16 (App Router) web application that serves as a digital reading platform for the Persian translation of **"Building Microservices"** by Sam Newman (O'Reilly Media, 2021, ISBN: 978-1492034025). The project provides a polished, feature-rich reading experience for Persian-speaking software architects, engineers, and students interested in microservices architecture.

### 1.2 Key Characteristics

| Aspect | Details |
|--------|---------|
| **Framework** | Next.js 16.4.6 (App Router, React 19.3.0) |
| **Language** | TypeScript (strict mode) |
| **Styling** | Tailwind CSS 4.3.3 (CSS-first configuration) |
| **Font** | Vazirmatn (Persian/Arabic optimized) via `next/font/google` |
| **Content Format** | Markdown with YAML frontmatter |
| **State Persistence** | localStorage (client-side only) |
| **Deployment Target** | Vercel (recommended), Docker, standalone Node.js |
| **Content** | 16 chapters across 3 parts + front/back matter |

### 1.3 Project Maturity

The project is **feature-complete for MVP** with:
- ✅ Complete book structure (16 chapters, 3 parts, front/back matter)
- ✅ Chapter 1 fully translated and implemented
- ✅ Reading interface with all controls functional
- ✅ Theme system (light/dark/sepia/auto)
- ✅ Reading progress tracking
- ✅ Bookmarks with notes
- ✅ Full-text search
- ✅ Keyboard navigation
- ✅ RTL/RTL support
- ⚠️ Chapters 2-16: Structure defined, Markdown files exist but content appears to be placeholder/empty
- ⚠️ English translation system defined but not fully integrated in UI
- ⚠️ Some components reference missing image assets

## 2. Project Purpose & Use Cases

### 2.1 Primary Purpose

To provide a **high-quality, accessible Persian-language reading experience** for "Building Microservices" — the definitive industry reference on microservices architecture — with modern web reading features that surpass static PDF/EPUB readers.

### 2.2 Target Audience

- **Persian-speaking software architects** seeking authoritative microservices guidance
- **Engineering teams** in Iranian/Persian-speaking organizations adopting microservices
- **Computer science students** in Persian-language curricula
- **Technical translators** as a reference for translation patterns

### 2.3 Use Cases

| Use Case | Implementation Status |
|----------|----------------------|
| Read chapters sequentially with navigation | ✅ Complete |
| Jump to specific chapters/sections via TOC | ✅ Complete |
| Search across all book content | ✅ Complete |
| Adjust font size, line height, text alignment | ✅ Complete |
| Switch themes (light/dark/sepia/auto) | ✅ Complete |
| Track reading progress per chapter | ✅ Complete |
| Add/remove bookmarks with notes | ✅ Complete |
| Keyboard-only navigation | ✅ Complete |
| Print/export chapters | 🟡 Partial (print CSS only) |
| Offline reading (PWA) | ❌ Not implemented |
| Multi-language (EN/FA) switching | 🟡 i18n system ready, UI not connected |

### 3.2 Technology Stack Details

| Category | Technology | Version | Purpose |
|----------|------------|---------|---------|
| **Framework** | Next.js | 16.4.6 | App Router, SSR/SSG, Image Optimization |
| **Runtime** | React | 19.3.0 | UI Components, Hooks, Context |
| **Language** | TypeScript | 5.x | Type Safety, Developer Experience |
| **Styling** | Tailwind CSS | 4.3.3 | Utility-first CSS, CSS Variables theming |
| **Font** | Vazirmatn | Latest | Persian/Arabic optimized via `next/font` |
| **Markdown** | gray-matter + remark | 4.0.3 / 15.0.1 | Frontmatter parsing, GFM support |
| **Icons** | lucide-react | 1.72.0 | Consistent icon system |
| **Linting** | ESLint | 9.x | Code quality, Next.js config |
| **Build** | Turbopack | 4.3.3 | Fast development builds |

### 3.3 Key Architectural Decisions

1. **App Router over Pages Router** — Modern Next.js patterns, React Server Components support
2. **Client-side only state (localStorage)** — No backend required, works as static export
3. **CSS Variables for theming** — Native browser theming, no CSS-in-JS overhead
4. **Markdown content source** — Version-controllable, translator-friendly, git-diffable
5. **TypeScript strict mode** — Maximum type safety across the codebase
6. **Component colocation by feature** — `components/ui`, `components/reader`, `components/home`, `components/layout`

## 5. Core Features & Functionality

### 5.1 Reading Interface (ReaderLayout)

**File:** `components/reader/ReaderLayout.tsx`

The main reading shell providing:

- **Responsive layout**: Desktop sidebar (72px fixed) + mobile drawer
- **Sticky header**: Back to home, chapter info, controls
- **Collapsible chapter TOC**: Right sidebar on desktop, modal on mobile
- **Reading progress bar**: Top of content area with percentage
- **Bottom navigation**: Previous/Next chapter links + TOC link
- **Scroll tracking**: Debounced progress persistence (200ms)
- **Keyboard shortcuts**: Full navigation via keyboard
- **Accessibility**: Skip link, ARIA labels, semantic HTML

### 5.2 Chapter Content Rendering

**File:** `components/reader/ChapterContent.tsx`

Renders structured `ContentSection[]` into semantic HTML:

| Section Type | Rendering |
|--------------|-----------|
| `heading` | `<h2>`-`<h6>` with auto-generated IDs for anchoring |
| `paragraph` | `<p>` with relaxed line height |
| `image` | `<figure>` with lazy-loaded `<img>`, optional caption |
| `code` | `<pre><code>` with language class for syntax highlighting |
| `blockquote` | `<blockquote>` with blue accent border |
| `list` | `<ul>` with nested list support (custom SVG bullets) |
| `table` | Responsive `<table>` with striped rows, RTL alignment |

**ChapterMeta component** displays: part title, chapter number/title, page number, reading time, word count.

### 5.3 Home Page (Table of Contents View)

**File:** `app/page.tsx`

Three-section layout:
1. **Front Matter** — Preface, acknowledgments, etc.
2. **Parts & Chapters** — 3 parts × ~4-5 chapters each, expandable sections
3. **Back Matter** — Epilogue, bibliography, glossary, index

Each `PartSection` renders chapters with section previews and page numbers.

### 5.4 Reading Controls (ReaderControls)

**File:** `components/reader/ReaderControls.tsx` (referenced)

Dropdown panel with:
- **Theme selector**: Light/Dark/Sepia/Auto with icons
- **Font size**: 6 levels (xs → 2xl) with live preview
- **Line height**: 4 levels (tight → loose)
- **Text alignment**: Justify/Right/Left
- **Navigation buttons**: Previous/Next chapter
- **Bookmark button**: Add/remove bookmark at current position
- **Progress display**: Current chapter progress percentage
- **Reset settings**: Restore defaults

### 5.5 Theme System

**Files:** `app/providers.tsx` (ThemeProvider), `lib/hooks/useTheme.ts`, `app/globals.css`

Four theme modes:
| Mode | Description | CSS Selector |
|------|-------------|--------------|
| `light` | Clean white background | `[data-theme="light"]` |
| `dark` | Dark slate background | `[data-theme="dark"]` |
| `sepia` | Warm paper-like background | `[data-theme="sepia"]` |
| `auto` | Follows system preference | Media query |

**Features:**
- Persists to `localStorage` (`book-archive-theme`, `book-archive-reader-settings`)
- System preference listener for `auto` mode
- CSS variable injection for font size, line height, text alignment
- Meta theme-color updates for mobile browsers
- Smooth transitions (200ms)

### 5.6 Reading Progress Tracking

**Files:** `app/providers.tsx` (ReadingProgressProvider), `components/ui/ReadingProgress.tsx`

- **Per-chapter scroll percentage** stored in `localStorage`
- **Visual progress bar** at top of content
- **Scroll indicator** on sidebar showing position
- **Debounced saves** (200ms) to avoid localStorage thrashing
- **Restores scroll position** on revisit (via `ScrollRestoration` component)

### 5.7 Bookmarks System

**Files:** `app/providers.tsx` (BookmarksProvider), `lib/hooks/useBookmarks.ts`

Full-featured bookmarking:
- **Position-aware**: Stores chapter, scroll position, section title
- **Notes support**: Optional text note per bookmark
- **Color coding**: 8 predefined colors for visual organization
- **Per-chapter filtering**: `getBookmarksForChapter(slug)`
- **Import/Export**: JSON file backup/restore
- **Duplicate detection**: By ID on import
- **UI hook**: `useBookmarkUI(chapterSlug)` for modal management

## 6. Data Models & Type System

### 6.1 Core Domain Types (`lib/types/book.ts`)

The type system is exceptionally comprehensive with **100+ interfaces** organized by domain:

#### Book Structure Types
```typescript
BookMetadata       // Title, author, translator, ISBN, tags, etc.
BookStructure      // Front matter, parts[], back matter
BookPart           // Part number, title, chapters[]
ChapterRef         // Number, title, slug, page, sections[]
SectionRef         // Title, level, subsections[], slug
FrontMatterItem    // Slug, title, page, order
BackMatterItem     // Slug, title, page, order
```

#### Chapter Content Types
```typescript
ChapterContent     // Slug, number, title, part*, page, readingTime, wordCount, sections[]
ContentSection     // Discriminated union: heading|paragraph|image|code|blockquote|list|table
ListItem           // Content, children[], checked (for task lists)
TableRow           // Cells[], isHeader
ChapterMetadata    // Original title, translators[], reviewers[], lastUpdated, version, tags[]
```

#### Navigation Types
```typescript
NavigationItem     // Slug, title, type (frontMatter|chapter|backMatter), hierarchy
ChapterNavigation  // Previous/next, current part, chapter index
```

#### Reading Experience Types
```typescript
ThemeMode          // 'light' | 'dark' | 'sepia' | 'auto'
FontSize           // 'xs' | 'sm' | 'base' | 'lg' | 'xl' | '2xl'
LineHeight         // 'tight' | 'normal' | 'relaxed' | 'loose'
TextAlign          // 'justify' | 'right' | 'left'
ReaderSettings     // All above + showProgress, showTOC, autoScroll, scrollSpeed
ReadingProgress    // ChapterSlug, scrollPosition, maxScroll, percentage, timestamp
Bookmark           // ID, chapterSlug, chapterTitle, sectionTitle?, scrollPosition, note?, createdAt, color?
ReadingHistoryEntry // ChapterSlug, chapterTitle, readAt, progress, timeSpent
```

#### Search Types
```typescript
SearchResult       // Slug, title, type, partTitle, chapterNumber, snippet, highlights[], score
SearchIndex        // Chapters[], sections[]
SearchableChapter  // Slug, title, number, partTitle, partNumber, content (normalized)
SearchableSection  // ChapterSlug, chapterTitle, chapterNumber, partTitle, title, level, content
```

#### Component Props Types
```typescript
BaseComponentProps // className?, children?
ButtonProps        // variant, size, disabled, loading, onClick, leftIcon, rightIcon
IconProps          // name, size, strokeWidth, aria-*
LinkProps          // href, external, aria-label
```

#### Utility Types
```typescript
DeepPartial<T>     // Recursive partial
Optional<T, K>     // Make K optional
RequiredFields<T, K> // Make K required
Without<T, K>      // Omit keys
With<T, K, V>      // Add key with value
```

### 6.2 Type Safety Highlights

- **Discriminated unions** for `ContentSection.type` → exhaustive switching in renderers
- **Const assertions** for theme/font/alignment options → autocomplete in IDE
- **Branded types** not used but could enhance `slug` vs `string` distinction
- **Strict null checks** enabled → no implicit `any`, proper null handling

## 7. Content Management System

### 7.1 Markdown Pipeline

**Files:** `lib/utils/markdown.ts`, `lib/data/chapters.ts`

```
content/chapters/chapter-1.md
         │
         ▼
┌─────────────────────────┐
│ gray-matter (frontmatter)│
└───────────┬─────────────┘
            ▼
┌─────────────────────────┐
│ parseContentToSections() │  ← Custom markdown parser
└───────────┬─────────────┘
            ▼
    ContentSection[]
            │
            ▼
┌─────────────────────────┐
│ generateChapterContent() │  ← Adds readingTime, wordCount
└───────────┬─────────────┘
            ▼
      ChapterContent
```

### 7.2 Supported Markdown Elements

| Element | Syntax | Parsed To |
|---------|--------|-----------|
| Headings | `#` - `######` | `type: 'heading', level: 1-6` |
| Paragraphs | Plain text | `type: 'paragraph'` |
| Bold/Italic | `**text**`, `*text*` | Preserved in paragraph content |
| Code blocks | ```lang\ncode\n``` | `type: 'code', language, content` |
| Inline code | `` `code` `` | Preserved in paragraph |
| Blockquotes | `> text` | `type: 'blockquote'` |
| Images | `![alt](src "title")` | `type: 'image', src, alt, caption` |
| Links | `[text](url)` | Preserved in paragraph |
| Lists | `- item` (nested with 2-space indent) | `type: 'list', items[]` |
| Tables | `| a | b |\n|---|---|` | Not yet parsed (returns paragraph) |
| Horizontal rule | `---` / `***` | `<hr />` paragraph |

## 9. State Management & Persistence

### 9.1 React Context Architecture (`app/providers.tsx`)

Three independent providers composed in `Providers` component:

```tsx
<ThemeProvider>
  <ReadingProgressProvider>
    <BookmarksProvider>
      {children}
    </BookmarksProvider>
  </ReadingProgressProvider>
</ThemeProvider>
```

### 9.2 ThemeProvider

**State:** `theme`, `resolvedTheme`, `settings (ReaderSettings)`
**Persistence:** `localStorage` keys: `book-archive-theme`, `book-archive-reader-settings`
**Effects:**
- Applies `data-theme` + `data-resolved-theme` to `<html>`
- Injects CSS variables: `--font-size-base`, `--line-height-base`, `--text-align-base`
- Listens to `prefers-color-scheme` for `auto` mode
- Updates meta theme-color for mobile

### 9.3 ReadingProgressProvider

**State:** `progress: Record<chapterSlug, {percentage, timestamp}>`
**Persistence:** `localStorage` key: `book-archive-reading-progress`
**API:** `updateProgress(slug, percentage)`, `getProgress(slug)`

### 9.4 BookmarksProvider

**State:** `bookmarks: Bookmark[]` (sorted newest-first)
**Persistence:** `localStorage` key: `book-archive-bookmarks`
**API:** `addBookmark`, `removeBookmark`, `updateBookmark`, `getBookmarksForChapter`

### 9.5 Custom Hooks (`lib/hooks/`)

| Hook | Responsibility |
|------|----------------|
| `useTheme()` | Theme + settings management (mirrors ThemeContext) |
| `useBookmarks()` | Bookmark CRUD + import/export + UI state |
| `useBookmarkUI(chapterSlug)` | Modal state for adding bookmarks |
| `useKeyboardNavigation(shortcuts)` | Global keyboard shortcut registration |
| `useReadingProgress()` | Progress context consumer |

### 9.6 Keyboard Navigation (`lib/hooks/useKeyboardNavigation.ts`)

**Shortcuts implemented:**
| Key | Action |
|-----|--------|
| `←` / `→` | Previous/Next chapter |
| `t` | Toggle theme |
| `s` | Focus search |
| `b` | Toggle bookmark |
| `o` | Toggle TOC |
| `,` | Open settings |
| `?` | Show help |

## 10. Search & Navigation

### 10.1 Full-Text Search Engine (`lib/utils/search.ts`)

**Architecture:** In-memory index built at runtime (dev) or build time (static)

**Pipeline:**
1. **Index Generation** (`generateSearchIndex()`):
   - Iterates all chapters via `CHAPTER_ORDER`
   - Loads content via `getChapterContent(slug)`
   - Normalizes text (Persian/Arabic character folding)
   - Builds `SearchableChapter[]` and `SearchableSection[]`

2. **Query Processing** (`searchIndex()`):
   - Normalizes query (same pipeline)
   - Splits into terms
   - Scores each chapter/section via `calculateScore()`
   - Generates snippets + highlights
   - Returns sorted `SearchResult[]`

**Scoring Algorithm:**
- Base: term frequency × 10
- Phrase match bonus: +50
- Title/heading position bonus: +30 (start), +20 (first 100 chars)
- Length normalization: divide by log(textLength/1000)

**Features:**
- Persian/Arabic normalization (آأإ→ا, ة→ه, يى→ی, ک→ک)
- Section-level search (headings only)
- Snippet generation with context
- Highlight extraction
- Search suggestions (title prefix matching)
- HTML highlight markup for display

### 10.2 Navigation System

**Files:** `lib/constants/book.ts`, `lib/data/chapters.ts`

**Chapter Navigation:**
- `getPreviousChapter(slug)` / `getNextChapter(slug)` — linear through CHAPTER_ORDER
- `getChapterNavigation(slug)` — returns current, prev, next + part info
- `getAllSlugs()` — all frontMatter + chapters + backMatter slugs
- `getNavigationItems()` — typed items for TOC rendering

**TOC Navigation:**
- Full book TOC in sidebar (ReaderSidebar)
- Per-chapter TOC (ChapterTOC) with section links
- Smooth scroll to headings via auto-generated IDs

## 11. Internationalization (i18n)

### 11.1 Current Implementation (`lib/utils/i18n.ts`)

**Locales:** `fa` (Persian, RTL) | `en` (English, LTR)

**Translation Keys:** ~120 keys organized by namespace:
- `nav.*` — Navigation
- `reader.*` — Reader controls
- `theme.*` — Theme options
- `fontSize.*`, `lineHeight.*`, `alignment.*` — Settings
- `home.*`, `toc.*`, `chapter.*` — Page content
- `search.*`, `bookmark.*`, `progress.*` — Features
- `a11y.*` — Accessibility labels
- `error.*`, `footer.*` — System messages

**Utilities:**
- `t(key, locale)` — Get translation
- `getTranslations(locale)` — Get all messages
- `getDirection(locale)` — `'rtl' | 'ltr'`
- `getFontFamily(locale)` — CSS font stack
- `formatNumber(num, locale)` — Persian/English digits
- `formatDate(date, locale)` — Localized date formatting

### 11.2 Integration Status

- ✅ Translation data complete for both locales
- ✅ Utility functions implemented
- ⚠️ **Not connected to UI** — Components use hardcoded Persian strings
- ⚠️ **No locale switcher** in UI
- ⚠️ **No locale detection** (browser/URL/preference)
- ⚠️ `content/translations/` directory referenced in docs but files not verified

## 12. Accessibility & UX

### 12.1 Implemented Accessibility Features

| Feature | Implementation |
|---------|----------------|
| **Skip Link** | `#main-content` anchor, visible on focus |
| **Semantic HTML** | `<main>`, `<article>`, `<aside>`, `<header>`, `<footer>`, `<nav>` |
| **ARIA Labels** | All icon buttons, toggles, form controls |
| **ARIA States** | `aria-expanded`, `aria-disabled`, `aria-busy`, `aria-label` |
| **Focus Management** | Visible focus rings (2px, CSS variable), focus-visible |
| **Keyboard Navigation** | All interactive elements reachable, logical tab order |
| **Screen Reader** | `sr-only` utility, proper heading hierarchy (h1→h2→h3) |
| **Color Contrast** | Tailwind slate scale meets WCAG AA (4.5:1) |
| **Reduced Motion** | `@media (prefers-reduced-motion)` disables animations |
| **High Contrast** | `@media (prefers-contrast: high)` strengthens borders |
| **Print Styles** | Hides UI chrome, shows URLs, optimizes typography |
| **RTL Support** | `dir="rtl"` on `<html>`, logical CSS properties |

### 12.2 Persian-Specific Optimizations

- **Font**: Vazirmatn with `font-feature-settings: "liga" 1, "calt" 1, "kern" 1`
- **Text rendering**: `text-rendering: optimizeLegibility`
- **Digit conversion**: `toPersianDigits()` for all numeric display
- **Punctuation handling**: Search normalizes Persian/Arabic variants
- **Line breaking**: `text-justify: inter-word` for justified alignment

## 13. Development Workflow & Tooling

### 13.1 Available Scripts (`package.json`)

```json
{
  "dev": "next dev",           // Turbopack dev server
  "build": "next build",       // Production build
  "start": "next start",       // Production server
  "lint": "eslint"             // Lint check
}
```

### 13.2 TypeScript Configuration (`tsconfig.json`)

- **Target**: ES2017
- **Module**: ESNext (bundler resolution)
- **Strict**: true (all strict flags)
- **Paths**: `@/*` → `./*`
- **JSX**: react-jsx
- **Incremental**: true (faster rebuilds)

### 13.3 ESLint Configuration (`eslint.config.mjs`)

- Flat config format
- `eslint-config-next` base
- TypeScript-aware parsing

### 13.4 Tailwind CSS v4 Configuration (`app/globals.css`)

- **CSS-first config** via `@theme` directive
- **Design tokens**: Colors, spacing, typography, shadows, radii, transitions, z-index
- **4 themes**: Light, Dark, Sepia, Auto (media query)
- **Custom utilities**: `.prose`, `.btn`, `.card`, `.badge`, `.skeleton`, `.progress-bar`
- **Component styles**: Chapter content, buttons, cards, forms

### 13.5 Content Development Workflow (per `docs/CONTENT_GUIDE.fa.md`)

1. Create `content/chapters/chapter-N.md` with frontmatter
2. Update `lib/constants/book.ts` → `BOOK_STRUCTURE.parts[].chapters`
3. Add images to `public/images/chapterN/`
4. Test: `npm run dev` → `/book/chapter-N`
5. Verify: navigation, TOC, progress, bookmarks, search
6. Build: `npm run build`
7. Deploy
